messages:
Cheng: Quick flag — ran komodo-v2 (fp16->q4f) smoke on multilingual-srt dataset and I'm seeing two oddities: ruby/furigana detaching on vertical JP outputs, and bracket mirroring being wrong for Arabic (RTL). Repro attached below.

Cheng: ```
Input (vertical JP w/ ruby):
漢字｜かんじ。 
Expected decode: 漢字｜かんじ。
Komodo-v2 q4f decode: 漢字
｜かんじ .
(note space before period and punctuation moved to next line)
```

EvalBot: Batch eval summary (subset):
- JA-EN BLEU: baseline 32.4 -> komodo-v2-q4f 29.9 (-2.5)
- JA vertical-ruby failures: 34/1200
- AR bracket-mirror failures: 12/500
- COMET delta: -0.35
(see /artifacts/3370012345/)

Ben: Any recent tokenizer/detok changes? I remember a patch for 'space_in_ideograph' heuristic last week.

Anya: Yep we merged a tiny change in tokenizers/normalize.py that emits U+200B in some vertical-normalize paths. Could be related.

Dana: I can run a focused detok-only pass (decode-only, no quant) and compare raw token ids -> decode. Will run now and post diffs.

Cheng: Ty. Also please capture raw tokenized IDs for the failing samples. If the token boundaries already include an extra space token, bug is upstream; if not, then quant/decoder changed spacing.

Ben: I'll bisect tokenizers between commit a1b2c3..d4e5f6 for the normalize change. Might take a few hrs.

EvalBot: Small quick check output (first failing sample):
```
raw ids before detok: [345, 1024, 3, 78]
raw ids after decode (komodo q4f): tokens -> ['漢','字',' ', '。']
```

Anya: Interesting — decoder seems inserting U+0020 before punctuation during linewrap handling. Could be our vertical-linebreak rule hitting the wrong branch.

Dana: I ran detok-only and see same space insertion even with fp16 model. So it's likely detok+linebreak logic, not quant kernels.

Cheng: Good find. Plan: (1) Ben bisect to confirm which tokenizer change enabled the normalization flag, (2) Anya prepare a small patch to skip inserting soft-space before punctuation when 'vertical_ruby' flag set, (3) Dana create repro bundle and open ticket #4201 with examples/artifacts. Hit me once commits are ready, we'll do a canary roll.

Ben: On it. will report back with commit hash + minimal repro.

Anya: I'll draft patch and tests. adding a quick unit test for vertical w/ ruby.

Dana: Created ticket #4201 and uploaded repro zip to /tickets/4201/repro.zip :thumbsup:

Cheng: Great. Thanks team — if anyone hits related Arabic bracket mirror cases, please add examples to #4201 as well. :eyes:
